description: PostgreSQL 18 canonical inet B-tree ordering and MAC hash-index equality behavior
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_network_indexes (id int4 PRIMARY KEY, address inet NOT NULL, mac macaddr NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_network_address_btree ON type_matrix_network_indexes USING btree (address);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_network_mac_hash ON type_matrix_network_indexes USING hash (mac);
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_network_indexes WHERE address = '192.168.1.1/24'::inet;
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_network_indexes WHERE mac = '08002b:010204'::macaddr;
SELECT address FROM type_matrix_network_indexes WHERE address >= '192.168.1.1/24'::inet ORDER BY address;
SELECT address FROM type_matrix_network_indexes ORDER BY address;
